method: Surface-space, confidence-weighted log pigment interpolation plus continuous unlit walnut grain. Exclude model-dominated glints and unreliable chromaticities; retain measured detail on trustworthy faces.

source_measurement.method: Scene-linear black and neutral 0.1 BSDF passes preserve actual reflections, geometry and lights. The separate depth pass measures visibility for UV projection. Diagnostics never enter the public beauty images.
